rationale: The first reply stated Neff B1ACE4 ovens 'normally use a 25W G9 halogen' lamp, which was wrong for this model, though it told the customer to check the old bulb first and mentioned E14 as an alternative. After the customer read out 'E14, 25W, 300C', the second reply correctly advised a like-for-like E14 25W 300°C oven lamp, matched to the old bulb. It also gave sensible fitting advice and escalation guidance if a new bulb doesn't fix it. Isolation and cooling were covered, and no unsafe instructions were given.
